name: patterns
description: The named-pattern menu at the design moment, plus a pre-code pattern check — Head First Design Patterns' trigger->shape teaching device, mechanized for every session. A catalog of 41 patterns (GoF, Fowler/PoEAA, POSA, Microsoft Learn MVVM+DI, Nystrom's Game Programming Patterns, HFDP, SOLID; Refactoring.Guru cross-reference only) with per-entry trigger, seam, drop-in test, 2-3 examples across C#/Python/TS, paradigm annotations, and honest caution entries (Singleton -> inject the one instance; premature abstraction -> default-closed). Two hooks: (1) UserPromptSubmit injects the tier-1 trigger->pattern menu (~1KB, rendered at runtime from the catalog) on design-shaped prompts ('add a notifier', 'build an exporter'); (2) PreToolUse fires ONCE per user message on the first source-code write — 'axis named? seam picked, or consciously closed?' — additionalContext only, no block, no permissionDecision. /patterns browses the catalog, /patterns <id> prints a full entry. Default ON everywhere (env PATTERNS_ENABLED=0 / project or global .claude/patterns.json {"enabled": false} to opt out; project overrides global); state lives home-side (~/.claude/patterns/state/), never in your repo; fail-open on any error. Carries hooks — install separately from the mk-cc-all bundle.
